document_assessment.summary: Sample checker output for validating the wrapper contract before Word tracked-change application.

batch_readiness.readiness_summary: The sample includes unresolved source-path evidence, so the wrapper should insert comments but apply no tracked text edits.

gates.finding: One source note needs archival path verification before a direct correction is safe.
gates.required_action: Provide repository, collection, series, and folder or selected published source before direct redline.

checks.finding: The source note leads with a discovery URL instead of a controlling repository or selected published source.
checks.standard: FRUS source notes should identify the repository, collection, series, folder, file, or selected published source before URLs, scans, catalog records, or other discovery aids.
checks.comment_text: Replace the URL-only locator with the controlling repository path or selected published source before final style.
checks.verification_target: Repository, collection, series, folder, file, or selected published source for source-note-0001

checks.finding: No issue. This editorial note does not need a first-footnote source note because it supplies documentary citations and chronology in the note text.
checks.standard: Published Reagan and Bush volumes include editorial notes without first-footnote source notes when the note text itself carries the evidence.

checks.finding: No source-path issue. The source note identifies a repository, collection, file family, and date before any surrogate locator.
checks.standard: FRUS source notes should identify the controlling repository, collection, file family, folder, file, or selected published source before URLs, scans, catalog records, or other discovery aids.

global_comments.comment_text: Sample output is intended for wrapper validation and should not be applied to a production Word file.

style_discrepancy_tally.style_question: How much source-surrogate detail should appear in final source notes when the controlling source is otherwise supplied?
style_discrepancy_tally.variant_a: Repository path only, with surrogate detail retained in audit context.
style_discrepancy_tally.variant_b: Repository path plus NLR, RAC, FOIA, or catalog identifier in the printed source note.
style_discrepancy_tally.general_editor_question: Should the checker enforce a house form for source-surrogate detail, or preserve volume-specific variation until the General Editor decides?
